name: Long Night of the Mines Museums
beschreibung: The Zillertaler Bergbauernmuseum opens its doors for a long night with special tours guided by flashlight. Experience the history of mountain farming, listen to local legends and myths, and sample traditional Tyrolean dishes such as Kiachln and Schwarzbrotsuppe.
kurzbeschreibung: Special flashlight tour featuring legends, myths, and traditional cuisine at the mountain farming museum.
